htmx-over-HTTP probe

These controls are vanilla htmx (attributes only) hitting the /r/{iri} HTTP route — no WebTransport, no custom JavaScript, no build step. Run the server with CMS_DEV_OPEN=1 and open this page. If the fragments render and swap on click, the transport is proven and we proceed to the real page.

(The tag/type chips inside a rendered fragment still carry urn: hx-gets for the old wire shim, so clicking those won't navigate yet — that's exactly what the rewrite fixes. Use the buttons below to drive it.)
